extracted.intended_audience: journalists and media contacts (local and national) seeking press information from The Salvation Army USA
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational guidance for how journalists and media should request information, spokesperson access, and media assets from The Salvation Army USA (local vs. national inquiries).

rubrics_metrics.name: Local media contact requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: All local media are asked to first contact their local Salvation Army representative for all inquiries, including spokesperson requests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Local media should use their local Salvation Army representative as the primary contact for inquiries and spokesperson requests rather than contacting national headquarters directly. (Page also lists 'Territorial Press Contacts' and 'Local Contacts' for finding those representatives.)

rubrics_metrics.name: National media handling and contact point
rubrics_metrics.description: National media relations are handled by The Salvation Army National Headquarters in Alexandria, VA, and its public relations consultant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For national-level media requests, journalists should contact National Headquarters (Alexandria, VA) or the organization's public relations consultant; the page provides a 'National Media Request Form' for these inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the National Media Request Form for national requests
rubrics_metrics.description: For national media requests, please contact us using the form below: National Media Request Form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit national media inquiries via the provided form rather than ad hoc channels; the page also offers downloadable media assets and directs local media to local contacts even for asset/spokesperson requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Downloadable media assets available
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The newsroom provides downloadable media assets for use by media; however, the site reiterates that local media should first contact their local Salvation Army representative for inquiries including spokesperson requests.
